results.title: Colette
results.overview: She's got thirty minutes for lunch and a lot of phone calls to make.

results.title: Q-Pop
results.overview: Q-POP follows 23-year-old Quechua artist and viral sensation Lenin Tamayo, creator of “Q-Pop,” a genre that fuses K-Pop with Quechua, an Indigenous tongue that has endured for centuries but faces an uncertain future among younger generations. As his music gains national attention in Peru and begins attracting fans around the world, Lenin journeys from a working-class neighborhood outside Lima to the streets of Seoul, chasing a dream that once seemed impossible. Along the way, he takes on a mission larger than his own success: using pop music to help preserve and revitalize the language of his ancestors.

results.title: Khoonta
results.overview: A woman bound spiritually to a Himalayan river waits for her missing husband, as her village quietly slips into an uncertain future-where faith, memory, and nature begin to reveal truths no one is ready to face.

results.title: The Godless
results.overview: Patrick is a resident of a village in Ireland that has plagued by nightmares and under a strict curfew since a recent murder. Following the death of his mother, his uncle Tomás moves to the village and hires a private investigator to uncover the village’s mystery.

results.title: Alltag in der Ukraine #dontlookaway
results.overview: We sent cameras to Ukraine and asked people, “What would you like to tell us about your daily lives?” “What should we see?” This is what they want to show us. This is what their daily lives look like. This is their life. Please don’t look away!

results.title: The Form and the Silence
results.overview: Pushed by the precision of a demanding rehearsal, a young actress navigates the quiet tension between who she is and who she feels she needs to be.

results.title: No Contact
results.overview: Nostalgia, Black Eyed Peas, and the unwritten rules of New York City dating. When two strangers meet on a bench, a 21-day "break" turns into a masterclass on romance, airport running tropes, West Side Highway running etiquette, and what it actually takes to win someone back.

results.title: Siegfried
results.overview: Another day in the life of Siegfried.

results.title: Aves de Corral
results.overview: Juan plans to introduce his girlfriend Casilda during the weekend at the family home in the mountains. However, before arriving, Juan and his brother Santiago have to flee from a group of assassins who are chasing them by mistake. The killers belong to a criminal organization that includes Miki, who should never have been there, and Gus, a policeman infiltrated in the group who tries to take care of Miki. Meanwhile, Pinco, who should take Miki's place, enjoys the hospitality of the man in charge of the criminal organization, unaware of the problems that are coming their way.

results.title: The Game of Life
results.overview: Jack Folly is a smart, grumpy, unemployed A.I. programmer. When his girlfriend prods him to start pulling his weight financially, he makes a desperate stock market gamble using his new A.I. program "Babylon." But the play backfires, costing Jack his money, his relationship, and his sanity.

results.title: Tajmahal
results.overview: Some paint their beloved in the seven colors of the rainbow, some bring down the stars to adorn their lover’s hair, and some are willing to give away cities like Samarkand and Bukhara for a single beauty mark on her cheek. But what will a doctor, returning from America to his village, offer to the woman he loves?

results.title: GIRLZILLA
results.overview: Thea feels sexiest in the universe when she heads to the club—but the moment she steps onto the dance floor, a bitter struggle to find someone to make out with begins.

results.title: Mickey
results.overview: Mickey spent the last ten years exploring her transition process within the conservative context of Sinaloa, Mexico. Through digital archives, artistic reenactments, and deeply personal encounters, the film moves between tenderness and rage, transforming memory into an act of freedom. An exploration of self-perception and a non-punitive confrontation with the past.

results.title: Aqui Comem Os Pombos
results.overview: A young man spends a day at the beach, contemplating the sand, sea, and sky as he narrates his thoughts and memories. Through silence and fleeting moments, he reflects on loss, grief, longing, and the absence of someone he deeply loved.

results.title: Lucky Bastard
results.overview: Is Luck Real? Miles Foster is the subject of a sick experiment where a man tests the limit of invisible human powers which in this film is Luck.

results.title: Affection Affection
results.overview: In the winter on the French Riviera, a teenage girl goes missing on her birthday. Géraldine, an employee in the mayor's office, takes on the role of detective. Versions of the truth rapidly multiply as she struggles not to be overwhelmed by all the gossip and theories.

results.title: Nobody's Violence
results.overview: Follows a travelling girl offering euthanasia services in a dystopian world.
